series.context: Prior events (Part 1): On Whale Island, twelve-year-old Gon Freecss dreams of taking the perilous Hunter Exam, but Aunt Mito forbids it unless he completes an impossible challenge: catching the mythical Lord of the Swamp. Perched in a giant tree with his father's rod, Gon battles the colossal monster fish and lands it before the stunned villagers, proving his unshakable resolve.
